title: Trump wants Supreme Court help on mail ballots ahead of midterms
shortDescription: Trump filed an emergency appeal to the Supreme Court after being told he can't tighten rules for mail-in voting before the midterms.

title: See Trump tour GM site, tout US economy before Michigan primary
shortDescription: Trump visits Michigan's GM Proving Ground to promote his economic agenda and highlight gains for the U.S. auto industry.

title: Trump impulsa el fin del cambio de hora, pero enfrenta resistencia en el Senado
shortDescription: La propuesta para eliminar el cambio de hora y establecer un horario de verano permanente avanzó en la Cámara de Representantes, pero enfrenta resistencia en el Senado.

title: Trump's AI post spree shows Iran war, 2028 hats and Dylan Mulvaney nod
shortDescription: Donald Trump posted dozens of AI-generated images on Truth Social Sunday. They depict 2028 hats, jokes from his Washington dinner remarks and more.

title: Trump to Thune: Don't let Senate leave until SAVE Act is passed
shortDescription: President Trump is calling for Senate Majority Leader John Thune to keep the Senate in Washington until Republicans pass the SAVE America Act.

title: In rural Iowa, Republicans consider voting for a Democrat for governor
shortDescription: Democratic gubernatorial candidate Rob Sand, fueled by an $18 million war chest, welcomes Republicans on his 100-county tour of Iowa.

title: Legal fight over churches endorsing candidates renewed as midterms near
shortDescription: The so-called Johnson Amendment has long barred houses of worship from direct involvement in politics. But an ongoing legal fight could change that.

title: Brazil denies visas to US officials ahead of October election
shortDescription: Two Trump administration officials were denied visas by Brazil ahead of a planned trip to the country, Brazil's Foreign Ministry told USA TODAY.

title: Trump moves to strip immigrants' citizenship
shortDescription: The Department of Justice is accelerating denaturalization cases to strip immigrants' citizenship.

title: Trump presses pause on strikes in Iran
shortDescription: The Trump administration has paused U.S. strikes in Iran after nearly two weeks of military attacks.

title: 100 days until the midterms: Where do polling and redistricting stand?
shortDescription: Sunday, July 26, marks 100 days until the November midterms. Democrats are leading in the polls, but Republicans' current majority and redistricting wins give an edge.

title: Maine Democrats tap Troy Jackson for U.S. Senate bid
shortDescription: Troy Jackson has replaced Graham Platner as the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate from Maine after winning at the state’s nominating convention.

title: Appeals court blocks Trump order on mail-in ballots in 23 states, DC
shortDescription: The 1st U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals rejected the Trump administration's request to lift an injunction secured by Democratic-led states in June.

title: Biden ends legal bid to keep interview recordings private
shortDescription: Former President Joe Biden dropped his lawsuit that sought to block the release of recordings from interviews with his memoir ghostwriter.

title: 'Inaccurate' history museum? Trump orders signs installed
shortDescription: The executive order said temporary signs would “direct visitors to locations and resources for accurate information regarding America’s history.”

title: See Troy Jackson replace Graham Platner as Maine Senate Democrat nominee
shortDescription: Troy Jackson has officially replaced Graham Platner as the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate from Maine. See the moment delegates voted for Jackson.
